The company serves technology brands in sectors including wearable technology, producing smartwatch components and finished devices for its customers.

column6: Designs and sells TicWatch smartwatches with AI features
column9: Mobvoi is a technology company that develops consumer electronics, including smartwatches. The company is known for its TicWatch line of smartwatches, which incorporate AI and voice assistant features. Mobvoi also provides voice search and other AI-powered services.
